Access and Use of the Service

Service Description: The Service is designed to provide users with an artificial intelligence (“AI”)-powered health and wellness platform, through which users may receive: (a) AI-generated personalized wellness, fitness, and nutrition plans and recommendations informed by the goals, preferences, health information, and connected wearable device data that you provide; (b) AI-generated meal plans and grocery lists; (c) workout guidance and explanations; (d) proactive AI-generated notifications and insights (“Pulses”) based on your wearable data, training activity, and nutrition logs; (e) food logging, workout logging, and related tracking tools; (f) educational wellness content; and (g) supplementary human coaching services provided by strength coaches, certified nutritionists, and registered dietitians, as further described below. Certain features of the Service, including coaching services, may be available only to paid subscribers.

Coaching Services; Affiliated Practitioners: The Service may provide you with access to supplementary human coaching services delivered through in-app chat and text messaging by three types of coaches: (a) strength coaches, who focus on fitness, training, and body composition; (b) certified nutritionists, who focus on healthy eating habits, weight goals, meal planning, and general nutrition wellness; and (c) registered dietitians (each, a “Coach,” and collectively, “Coaches”). Strength coaches and certified nutritionists provide general wellness coaching services only; interactions with these Coaches are provided for general wellness and informational purposes only and do not constitute medical advice, medical nutrition therapy, or the practice of any licensed healthcare profession. Registered dietitians are licensed or credentialed nutrition professionals (“Affiliated Practitioners”) who may provide clinical nutrition services (including medical nutrition therapy), in each case solely to the extent permitted within such Affiliated Practitioner’s applicable scope of practice and licensure.
